name: Rokid VESC HUD
summary: Read-only Rokid AI Glasses HUD for VESC telemetry over BLE, with configurable board profiles and battery curves.
description: Read-only Rokid AI Glasses HUD for VESC telemetry over BLE, with configurable board profiles and battery curves.
author: ShaBP

releases.notes:
## What's new

- Added rounded duty-cycle percentage beside the current speed
- Added per-ride maximum speed and persistent per-board maximum speed
- Added configurable metric/imperial display units
- Tightened HUD spacing and moved lower status rows upward
- Added an up-to-date HUD screen example to the README

Tested with 13 passing unit tests. Install over an existing build with adb install -r.
